provenance.giver: Universal Dependencies treebank (train split), human-annotated gold
provenance.basis: K=5 contiguous folds; per fold a POS prior and a frame prior built from the other folds; every in-scope held-out word the prior had not met is read by classAt; floor = the naming mass below which only ALPHA of the true naming occurrences fall (cap 0.5)
provenance.note: the floor is a refusal bound, not a classifier: a word below it is refused, a word at or above it is kept and flagged class_unsettled when its frame does not settle it
